title: Bram and the Silence
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Xanthe Almeida, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
